writeup: Woot has the new eco4life S7 smart video doorbell (2.4G Wi-Fi) for $35.99. eco4life's own store sells the same S7 for $59.99, so this is 40% less, about $24 saved. It records 1080p HDR video, sends radar-verified person and package alerts, is IP65 rated and lasts up to 180 days on standby. Woot shows only one left, limit three per customer.
